title: GET /smart-compliance/questions/stats reflects an immediate archive of an active question
steps: Call GET /smart-compliance/questions/stats and note the active count
expectedResult: active count decreases by 1 and archived count increases by 1; total stays the same.

title: The assessment metadata step blocks 'Start Questions' until a Name is entered
steps: Open the questionnaire modal and immediately click 'Start Questions' without entering a Name
expectedResult: A validation toast 'Please fill in the required Name field before proceeding' is shown and the step does not advance; the Name field is marked touched/invalid.

title: A 'select' question rejects zero answers and rejects more than one answer
description: Quick boundary re-check of validateAnswers() for responseType='select' complementing SMCM-UNIT-001/003.
steps: Submit answers with an empty array for a select-type question
Submit answers with two values for the same select-type question
expectedResult: Both submissions are rejected with 400 validation errors ('Answer array is required and must not be empty' and '"..." requires exactly one answer' respectively).

title: 'Submit Assessment' is hidden for a user without smart_compliance.create on the selected project
description: Quick reverification that PermissionHide permission='smart_compliance.create' allowProjectGrant still gates the final submit button in CFRSQuestionnaireModal after any permissions-related deploy.
preconditions: User has smart_compliance.read only, no smart_compliance.create at org or project level
steps: Open the questionnaire and advance to the last question
expectedResult: The 'Submit Assessment' button is not rendered (or is hidden) for this user; only the Previous button and progress bar are visible.

title: Reopening a draft after the question count changed resumes at a bounded, in-range step rather than an out-of-bounds index
description: loadQuestionnaires() clamps the restored draft's currentQuestionIndex via Math.min(draft.currentQuestionIndex, sortedQuestions.length - 1) in case questions were added/removed from the catalog since the draft was saved.
preconditions: A draft was saved at question index 5 when the catalog had 6 questions; an admin has since archived questions down to 3 active
steps: Reopen the questionnaire modal for the same project
expectedResult: The modal resumes at question index 2 (the last valid index for 3 questions), not index 5 — no blank/undefined question is shown.
